description: The label and value rows of a detail page, with real dl, dt and dd. Rows with a label column and hairlines, stacked, or a grid of two or three columns, reflowing to stacked on a phone by container queries. Values arrive in a short cascade, and a copy button copies its value and confirms on itself with a drawn check.
moves: Items rise in one after another, 40ms apart, with a little blur, when the list first shows.
The copy button sinks and springs back.
Copied, the copy icon shrinks into a blur, a check pops in and draws itself in green, and two seconds later they swap back.
keyboard: Moves to each copy button and action in the list.
Copies the focused value; screen readers hear "Copied".

propDocs.DescriptionList.layout: "rows" (labels in a fixed column, hairlines between, the default), "stacked" (label above value) or "grid". All three stack below 28rem.
propDocs.DescriptionList.columns: For the grid: how many columns at full width, 1 to 4. Defaults to 2. Fewer show when a column would be under 11rem.
propDocs.DescriptionList.truncate: Keeps long values on one line with an ellipsis and the full text as a title. Off, they wrap.
propDocs.DescriptionList.speed: How fast it moves: "fast", "normal", "slow" or a multiplier.
propDocs.DescriptionListItem.value: An id for the item, when you need to key it.
propDocs.DescriptionListActions: Holds buttons or links at the end of a value: a copy button, an Edit button.
propDocs.DescriptionListCopy.value: The text to copy. Leave it out to copy the value beside the button.
propDocs.DescriptionListCopy.label: What the value is called, for the button's name ("Copy Email"). Read from the item's label when left out.

cssVars: Space above and below an item
